verdict.rationale: Plaid publishes an official Node SDK under its own GitHub org (plaid/plaid-node). It shows typed client calls like `plaidClient.transactionsSync` and promise-based error handling, and is supported by a cloneable Quickstart app and a fully featured Sandbox for development. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages, first-party SDK reference docs listing supported libraries, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
